summary: A concrete 4x4 Klein-Latin bus realizes the tomotope/Reye (12_4,16_3) layer and its q-2025-style oriented double cover (24_2,16_3). Pairing the two degree-2 observations over each axis quotients 24 observations back to 12 axes. The same 16 cells with three phase labels give the Holonet 16x3=48 tick body.
